Existing PolyRace uses continuous steering/drift/checkpoint time trial and ghost; native cycling discrete lanes/stamina and rival rank, no shared whole loop.
Known original moto/hill-driving has tilt/physics terrain/checkpoint time stars, distinct from flat multi-lane cycling race and stamina strategy.
